gotchas: Victron marks this record 'Record layout is still to be determined and might change.' It is vendor-authored text saying the vendor has not finished. Confidence is unverified for that reason alone — a field that moves by one bit silently produces wrong numbers, not an error.
Three declared fields (AC in power, AC out power, warnings/alarms) carry the literal text TBD with no start bit and no width. There is nothing to implement for them and nothing to guess.

This dialect is strictly worse than victron-gx-modbus-tcp for the same hardware: five values versus a thousand registers, encrypted with a key that must be typed in by hand, over a link with no delivery guarantee. It is recorded so nobody researches it twice, not because it is a route worth taking.
Which GX models actually advertise, and whether advertising is even enabled by default on a GX, is unrecorded. Both are bench questions.
